          SELECT

            a.hadm_id,
            a.admittime,
            a.dischtime,

            p.anchor_age + (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - p.anchor_year) AS age,

            `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp`.patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
